space_storage_shape_check.name: space_storage_shape_check
space_storage_shape_check.value: ("space_storage"."kind" = 'shared_folder' and "space_storage"."connection_id" is null) or ("space_storage"."kind" = 'google_account' and "space_storage"."connection_id" is not null and "space_storage"."root_folder_id" is not null)

style_reference_source_check.name: style_reference_source_check
style_reference_source_check.value: ("style_reference"."kind" = 'video' and "style_reference"."asset_id" is not null) or ("style_reference"."kind" = 'link' and "style_reference"."url" is not null) or ("style_reference"."kind" = 'project' and "style_reference"."project_id" is not null)
